title: Will the Democratic Party win the NY-09 House seat?

forecast.rationale: NY-09 is a heavily Democratic district in Brooklyn/Queens that has been held by Democrats for decades. The district has a strong Democratic voter registration advantage and demographic composition favoring Democrats. While the 2022 midterms showed some Republican gains in New York, NY-09 remains a safe Democratic seat with no realistic path for Republicans to flip it in 2026.

title: Will the Republican Party win the IL-06 House seat?

forecast.rationale: IL-06 is a suburban Chicago district that leans Democratic, currently held by incumbent Sean Casten who has won multiple consecutive elections. The district's Cook PVI favors Democrats, and 2026 midterms with Trump in the White House typically benefit the opposition party (Democrats), making a Republican pickup less likely though not impossible.

title: Will the Republican Party win the NM-02 House seat?

forecast.rationale: NM-02 has a Republican-leaning PVI (around R+5 to R+6), and Democrat Gabe Vasquez has won two consecutive narrow victories. While Vasquez has built some incumbency advantage, the district's underlying partisan lean and typical midterm dynamics (which often favor the party out of the White House) make Republican recapture plausible. The race is expected to be highly competitive.

title: Will the Republican Party win the PA-02 House seat?

forecast.rationale: PA-02 is held by incumbent Republican Brian Fitzpatrick, a moderate who has consistently won this competitive Bucks County district, including a strong 57% victory in 2024. While 2026 midterm dynamics typically disadvantage the president's party and suburban Philadelphia has trended Democratic, Fitzpatrick's personal brand and incumbency provide significant protection. The main risks are retirement or an unusually strong Democratic wave.

title: Will the Democratic Party win the CA-12 House seat?

forecast.rationale: CA-12 (San Francisco area) is one of the safest Democratic districts in the country, with a Cook PVI of D+40 or higher. Nancy Pelosi held this seat for decades, and it has been reliably Democratic for generations. There is virtually no realistic scenario where Republicans win this seat.

title: Will the Democratic Party win the VA-01 House seat?

forecast.rationale: VA-01 is a strongly Republican district with a Cook PVI of approximately R+10 to R+12. Rob Wittman has held the seat since 2007, consistently winning with 60%+ of the vote. Even in favorable Democratic environments, this district has remained safely Republican, making a Democratic victory in 2026 highly unlikely.
